case_title: P. Eknath v. Y. Amaranatha Reddy @ Babu & Anr.
evidence_type: Medical, eyewitness, circumstantial, recovery, dying declaration
confession: Confessional statement recorded in the presence of witnesses
aggravating_circumstances: Double murder, use of a sharp-edged weapon, motive of unpaid loan
trial_court_outcome: Convicted and sentenced to life imprisonment and fine of Rs. 5,000
offence_finally_established: Murder under Section 302, Attempt to murder under Section 307
neutral_facts: The accused entered the home of the deceased, who was the head of the family, and attacked him with a sickle, causing severe injuries. The accused also attacked the deceased's daughter, resulting in her death. The accused was identified by eyewitnesses and the weapon used was recovered from the scene. The deceased's wife, who was also present, witnessed the attack and provided a dying declaration. Medical reports indicated that the injuries were caused by a sharp-edged weapon, and the accused was found in possession of the weapon. The trial court convicted the accused for the murders and attempted murders, while the High Court acquitted him, which was overturned by the Supreme Court.
